what: NATURE + PLANT OBSERVATIONS from photo-organizer lap 26 — nine findings from a 115-card window Paul ruled 2026-09-01, all in his own words, none identified by any model. Two days running; 'fuzzy' is his description, not a species. THREE facts: a planting event, MOM'S OWN ACT, and the first recorded content of the-green-terrace. rhododendron is NOT an entry in plants.json (azalea is Rhododendron spp. but he named it distinctly and said it was FOUND on the property). (4) JAPANESE MAPLE, cards 26-27 — Paul: 'a small Japanese maple by the pond'. japanese-maple sits in plants.json with NO zone; this proposes pond-area. (5) BEAR, cards 87-88 and video 113 — Paul said 'bears... or a bear' and CORRECTED HIMSELF TO ONE; the correction is kept. mammals.json. (6) KOI, cards 108-109 — 'the Koi in the pond'. (7) FROGS, card 4 — 'a bunch of frogs in the little upper pond in the pond area'. ⚠️ 'the little UPPER pond' — the record holds one pond-area; whether a distinct upper pond exists is NOT established. (8) WILDFLOWERS, cards 39-42. (9) ⭐ SPRINKLER AND ZONE DESIGN, card 74 (a .MOV) — Paul: 'the sprinkler going, it's on the bluff watering the western garden and the fern or the green terrace'. HIS HEDGE IS UNRESOLVED — he named two candidates and did not choose; do not pick one. Bears on zone design: one sprinkler waters ACROSS several zone boundaries, which is expected when those zones sit 5-7 m apart inside a ±9.1 m trace error. A zone names ground, not a watering unit. ⚠️ EVERY ITEM IS AN OBSERVATION AWAITING PAUL OR MOM — nothing here is identified, and photo-organizer wrote nothing to Fernwood's canon.

what: PLANTS × ZONES — a table of what is already known, and it needed no new review. [paul-stated 2026-09-01: 'if we can kind of identify what plants are in what zones and pass that on to Fernwood, that's a huge amount of progress we can make.'] READ: photo-organizer/reports/plant-zone-table.md, derived by tools/plant_zone_table.py — regenerate any time; nothing in it is typed. ⭐ IT KEEPS TWO SOURCES APART ON PURPOSE. Column 1 is PAUL'S WORD (plants.json zones, canon). Column 2 is PHOTOGRAPHS — the zone polygon under a photo he ruled with that plant as its subject. They are never merged, because a photograph's zone is where the CAMERA stood and 17 of 23 zones sit closer together than the ±9.1 m trace error. The photographic column CORROBORATES or CONFLICTS; his word wins every time. Both cases are live right now: constellation-dogwood agrees with his word (the-green-ring ×2), and mountain-laurel CONFLICTS (photos in lawn and the-bluff) — which is exactly the plant he named three zones for, none of them where he was standing. A conflict here is evidence about the photographer, not about the plant. ⭐⭐ ONE ITEM IS READY FOR A ONE-WORD CONFIRMATION: japanese-maple is UNZONED in plants.json, Paul said 'a small Japanese maple by the pond' on 2026-08-29, AND a photograph independently falls inside pond-area. His word and the geometry agreeing is the strongest evidence any unzoned plant has. Proposed: zones [{zoneId: pond-area}]. NOT written — plants.json is this repo's canon. ⭐ A SECOND, WEAKER ONE: boxwood is unzoned and has photographs in `house` ×2 and nothing else. That is geometry alone, in a LOW-confidence zone (nearest neighbour 7.1 m, under the trace error), so it is raised as a question and explicitly NOT proposed. STATE: 18 of 37 plants carry a zone; 19 do not — white-pine, hydrangea, boxwood, holly, japanese-maple, pyracomeles-berry-box, deutzia-yuki-cherry-blossom, clematis, butterfly-weed, wisteria-summer-cascade, clematis-elpis, hydrangea-dreamcloud, endless-summer-pop-star-hydrangea, spiderwort, creeping-fig, lizards-tail, crocosmia, garden-phlox, hydrangea-panicle. ⚠️ AND THE MEASURED REASON NOT TO EXPECT A MACHINE TO CLOSE THAT GAP: every automated route to plant IDENTITY was tested and is dead. Zone geometry is ANTI-CORRELATED with the question — 1,321 plant photographs sit in unresolvable zones against 395 in separable ones, because the plants are around the house and the house cluster is precisely what the trace cannot separate. Bloom windows are 2-4 months wide and each selects 374-1,046 of 3,186. Apple's labels stop at Plant/Shrub/Tree — no species. CLIP is excluded by Paul's own standing rule, deterministic over ML. The clusters are scene-shaped, the largest holding 649 photographs. IDENTIFICATION NEEDS A HUMAN EYE OR A LABEL IN THE FRAME, and that is a finding, not a shortfall. NEXT, if this loop wants it: nine zone×plants contact sheets are already built in photo-organizer (hosta-garden, the-bank, the-meadow, lower-40, fern-garden, western-fern-azalea-garden, eastern-woodlands, eastern-patio, the-green) for the review Paul proposed — show the photograph, propose the zone, let him confirm the ZONE without needing to name the plant. His confirmations would also become the structured zone attributions the reverse join has been missing.

what:
⭐⭐ PLANT IDENTIFICATION HANDOFF — 56 photographs, ZONE-CONFIRMED BY PAUL, PLANTS NOT NAMED. This is the half photo-organizer cannot do, handed over deliberately. His design, 2026-09-01: 'what if you just show me pictures of plants that are on the Fernwood property with a hypothesis of the zone, and I confirm what zone it's in? And then we can pass it on to Fernwood to kind of identify those plants.' It splits a question no instrument could answer whole — he does not need to know WHAT a plant is to say WHERE it is. 

READ: photo-organizer/reports/plant-zone-table.md, section 'Photographs CONFIRMED to a zone — the identification handoff'. Derived by tools/plant_zone_table.py; regenerate any time. Source rulings: reports/botanical-plants-zone-confirm.answers.json, sweep 155. EVERY CARD CARRIES zone_confirmed AS A LIST AND zone_hypothesis_agreed AS A BOOLEAN — fields, not prose, so a join can read them. 

PER ZONE: pond-area 28 · st-francis-garden 6 · western-fern-azalea-garden 4 · western-garden 3 · the-meadow 3 · hosta-garden 3 · eastern-woodlands 3 · the-green-ring 2 · eastern-patio 1 · lower-parking 1 · lower-40 1 · fern-garden 1. Work a zone at a time; 28 photographs of the pond area is a sitting. 

⭐⭐ THE NUMBER THIS PRODUCED, AND IT MATTERS TO ANY FUTURE PLANT WORK: THE POLYGON HYPOTHESIS AGREED WITH HIM 6 TIMES OUT OF 56 — 11%. The camera-vs-subject rule has been stated in his own words since 2026-08-10 and never measured. Against 56 human rulings, point-in-polygon is not a weak signal for plants, it is close to noise. ⛔ DO NOT AUTO-ASSIGN A zoneId FROM PHOTO GEOMETRY. The 50 corrections are the valuable part. 

⚠️ THE SELECTOR WAS WRONG TWICE BEFORE IT WAS RIGHT, and the record should carry why: (1) this repo's `nature-plant` is a TAXONOMY ROLL-UP that fires on any landscape with vegetation in it — 2,655 photographs at Fernwood against 607 genuinely botanical. Paul walked 111 and said 'the zones are right, but they're not actually pictures of plants.' (2) The geofence reached 1,485 m; 232 of 314 sit within 50 m of the house and the next 250 m adds eleven. (3) 'High quality pictures of plants around the house' — stills only, ranked on Apple's component scores. ⚠️ APPLE'S COMPOSITE overall_aesthetic IS EMPTY on all 229 in this library while all 13 components are populated, and `curation` penalises VIDEO wholesale. 

⭐ AND A CORRECTION TO SOMETHING PHOTO-ORGANIZER TOLD THIS LOOP EARLIER TONIGHT: it said Apple's labels 'top out at Plant/Shrub/Tree — no species'. THAT IS FALSE. Apple carries Maple Tree, Oak Tree, Fire Lily, Oxeye Daisy, Beach Rose, Ostrich Fern, Daisy, Sunflower, Rose, Orchid — rare, but real and species-level. The earlier claim came from reading the frequency-ordered TOP 30, which is all generic labels. If any plant-identification work was scoped on that claim, RE-SCOPE IT. 

⚠️ FOUR THINGS HELD RATHER THAN GUESSED, each needing Paul or Mom: (a) BLACK-EYED SUSANS — he says he is 'trying to consolidate them onto the PARKING BANK', but parking-bank is TOMBSTONED on his own 2026-08-31 ruling and its successors (the-bank, lower-parking) cover different ground. Also black-eyed Susan is NOT in plants.json, and 'trying to consolidate onto' is an INTENTION, not a location. (b) BOXWOODS 'by the parking area' — main-parking or lower-parking not said. ⭐ It is also a real CORRECTION: the plant-zone table had boxwood as photographs-only in `house`, geometry alone, and his word moves it. (c) MOSS — he named the subject, not the place. (d) A TOAD, which is not a plant and belongs to the wildlife record. 

⚠️ NOTHING WAS WRITTEN TO plants.json FROM THIS. 19 of 37 plants still carry a zone; 18 do not.
